en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing a severely iced shoreline or lakeside scene. Thick layers of ice and frozen spray cover railings, rocks, and other structures along the water's edge. Utility poles and a large telephone/telegraph line support frame run into the distance on the right, also encased in ice. The water body to the left appears rough and wintry, with bare trees in the background. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.
